This '''jewel shop''' was a pawn shop specializing in jewels and other gems, located in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Darlyn Boda (city)|Darlyn Boda]] on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Darlyn Boda/Legends|Darlyn Boda]].

==History==
The [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[4-LOM/Legends|4-LOM]] first embarked upon a career devoted to crime after jumping ship from his assignment aboard the [[Luxury liner/Legends|luxury liner]] [[Kuari Princess/Legends|''Kuari Princess'']] at Darlyn Boda, before consigning the stolen [[Ankarres Sapphire]] to the jewel shop. 4-LOM returned to the shop [[Standard year/Legends|years]] later to purchase the [[Sapphire/Legends|sapphire]] back.
